notes.title: Voidrun 1.06
notes.content:
Some minor fixes :


ERGONOMY

Methuselah transparency zone is now larger.


BUGFIXES

You can now use mouse to skip gameover / replay arcade mode / change color palette.
Fixed a bug where some perks added in arcade mode were not active
Skip gameover won't lock color palette anymore

notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34697511/1b113b13644c328d689942b742111dcc400bd572.png
GAMEPLAY

 reworked Arcade mode : You now start with no perk and choose new perk at wave at the start of wave 2,3,5,7,10,??
 removed some perks from arcade mode : WRENCH, BOMB
 Added exclusive arcade perks : EXTRA_LIFE, TIME_JUMP, GREED
 Arcade difficulty now increase 30% slower on each wave.
 Powerups now vanish after 30 seconds 
 Rift effect improved ( destroy 15 squares instead of 10 )
 +2 Live in adventure mode
 replaced big cliffs on Korbulys-3  with smaller ones ( no more mecha legs stuck in cliff )
 You can't spawn near mines anymore


ERGONOMY

 Game over is now skippable
 Now ask for retry after arcade


BUGFIX

 Fixed bug when game over or level intro message stay on next screen.
 Fixed bad mouse coordinates on some resolution.
